LESSON: KENYAN INDIGENOUS GAMES (OPTIONAL)

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)
2. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) in the examples.
2. Explain Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)
2. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Kenyan Indigenous Games (Optional)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
